test_target.scope: temporary controller response qualification with available illumination; production controls remain protected

controls.exclusion_rule: Only adjusted, awaiting_applied_controls and settling states; unavailable metadata is never excluded. Final-tail original gates remain mandatory.

measurement_boundaries: Temporary target qualifies controller response under available illumination; it does not replace the production-target stationary test.
Status snapshots can miss updates. Per-step bounds and monotonicity qualify only if the observed step count equals the update-counter delta.
Human confirmation time can follow the physical switch and the start of a response; no precise response latency is inferred.
One increase-to-decrease reversal is expected for this off/on cycle; additional direction runs fail the cycle check.
Luma span is temporal variation of a spatial median; this report does not identify a noise/flicker cause or measure image detail.
Sensor control metadata does not measure physical PIO pulse timing.

preview_payload_validation.scope: Local independent decoding of first retained payload only; each decoder starts in a fresh process. No images published. Darkness is measured after decoding and does not prove its physical cause.

visual_inspection.observations: All three show a coherent board/target scene with a mostly dark background. No obvious partial-frame corruption, displaced color planes or decode artifacts. Rectified JPEG has changed framing consistent with geometric remapping. H.264 shadows are darker; these are separately captured first frames, so this is not a controlled codec quality/range comparison.
visual_inspection.limitations: Single-frame pixel validation does not establish sustained image quality, calibration accuracy or correct exposure under changing light. Status counter snapshots do not share exact boundaries with received-frame windows, so counter deltas of 198/199 differ from 200 measured deliveries.

limits: Targets were 10 Hz and 1 Hz; this does not measure maximum throughput or establish a matcher speedup.
Candidate stage statistics sample about 3.33 Hz versus 10 Hz baseline; local capture-to-reply latency uses every observed frame.
Sequential workloads retain allocations; soak follows all-product/preview checks and has different illumination from baseline comparisons.
Initial dark-scene brightness stability failed while exposure was held at its ceiling. This does not identify the physical cause of luma variation.
The first light-on ended within the default median band; the expected-decrease assertion failed because a decrease was not required.
Bidirectional physical-light response used temporary target40 band35..45; default target75 band65..85 separately passed stationary hold.
Human light-switch confirmations are not instrumented event times. No precise response latency, physical XTR edge timing, quantitative noise/detail or metric accuracy claim.
Five minutes is a bounded sustained-run check, not long-duration endurance or qualification of smaller RAM variants.
Raw traces and camera images stay local; this record contains derived results and hashes only.
